name: Lower Manhattan
title: Hudson River Paddling Conditions Near Lower Manhattan, NY
blurb: Hudson River Park, where the river is at its widest and its fastest. Busy with ferries and commercial traffic, and the current runs harder here than anywhere upriver.

tide.label: NOAA 8518750 The Battery
tide.note: Tide from NOAA station 8518750 at The Battery, two miles downriver.
tide.cardNote: Unless you plan on landing on a beach or poking into a shallow creek, tide is likely not very important to you.

current.label: NOAA NYH1927_13 Hudson River Entrance
current.note: Current from NOAA station NYH1927_13 (Hudson River Entrance), about a mile and a half downriver, at the 7 ft bin nearest the surface.
